title: Port lookup with form card
request: Well-known port lookup. Known services: ssh 22, smtp 25, dns 53, http 80, https 443, postgres 5432, redis 6379, mongodb 27017. If the message names a known service (as a whole word), reply '<service> uses port <port>'. If no known service is mentioned, reply 'Which service?' with a form card containing a select field named 'service' whose options are the eight services, and a submit button whose selection is {"action":"lookup"}. When the submitted form arrives as JSON (e.g. {"action":"lookup","service":"redis"}) answer the same way.
